primary_conclusion: No candidate completion advantage over V3 hybrid; 140/160 each and identical paired primary outcomes. Exhibit release costs 4 versus 3 credits with both failing; candidate additionally stores the private annex.

inputs.raw_corpus_digest_definition: SHA-256 of canonical JSON mapping raw basename to SHA-256 of unchanged compressed bytes

units.seed_independence: Noise timing/text variants within eight authored case structures; no independent-world or population-confidence claim.

limitations: Procedurally independent task author within one project, not an external benchmark or access-control barrier.
Eight authored cases are the generalization unit; all outcome/resource/assertion patterns are constant across the twenty noise seeds for every case-arm pair.
Typed public goals/actions/conditions, acceptance flags, institutional completion registers and shared recovery policy supply substantial task structure.
V3 hybrid is the controlled candidate ablation. Lexical/latest arms also differ in consolidation and representation, so all baseline differences cannot be attributed to one retention bonus.
State accounting is a declared logical serialized footprint including real lexical index/query material, not Python RSS or a wall-clock efficiency comparison.
Hidden-state and source-loss cases have explicit observation and revocation requirements; no counterfactual hidden-value variants or no-inspection ablations were run.
The all-arm exhibit failure is retained as scored; it is not evidence that publication was impossible for an ideally retained approval set.
